do_if.value: player.module == 'custom_creative' and md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$epoch? and md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector1? and md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector2? and @$v.$epoch == md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$epoch and @md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector1.isclass.sector and @md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector2.isclass.sector and md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector1 != md.X4AuthoritySectorReferenceFixture.State.$sector2

@$ship1.isoperational and $ship1.isclass.ship and $ship1.macro == macro.ship_arg_s_fighter_01_a_macro and $ship1.owner == faction.player and $ship1.sector == $sector1 and @$ship1.pilot == null and $ship1 != player.ship and $ship1 != player.occupiedship and not $ship1.dock.exists and not $ship1.isinternallystored

@$ship2.isoperational and $ship2.isclass.ship and $ship2.macro == macro.ship_arg_s_fighter_01_a_macro and $ship2.owner == faction.player and $ship2.sector == $sector2 and @$ship2.pilot == null and $ship2 != $ship1 and $ship2 != player.ship and $ship2 != player.occupiedship and not $ship2.dock.exists and not $ship2.isinternallystored

debug_text.text: '[X4LAN] AUTH_PLAYER_FIXTURE slot=1 ship=%s sector=%s parent=%s position=%s hull=%s pilot=%s'.[$ship1, $sector1, $ship1.parent, $ship1.position, $ship1.hullpercentage, @$ship1.pilot]
'[X4LAN] AUTH_PLAYER_FIXTURE slot=2 ship=%s sector=%s parent=%s position=%s hull=%s pilot=%s'.[$ship2, $sector2, $ship2.parent, $ship2.position, $ship2.hullpercentage, @$ship2.pilot]
